strategy.summary: US$1,000, US-listed only, USD. One stock a day or flat; flat by the close. 5-minute opening range breakout on stocks in play, long only.
strategy.framing: Day trading is the hardest version of this test — most retail day traders lose. The best published intraday evidence is Zarattini, Barbon & Aziz (2024): a 5-minute ORB on stocks in play, 1% risk, exit at the close. Expect roughly flat with a low win rate (30-45%) and a few big winners.
rules: Pick one: highest first-bar rvol (≥2) with a green first 5-min candle and a gap ≥ +0.5%, preferably with a catalyst. Otherwise FLAT.
Entry: buy-stop at the opening range high from bar 2 on, fill + 0.1% slippage, must trigger by 11:00 ET.
Stop: opening range low, at least 0.3% below entry. No moving the stop down, no averaging down.
Target: hold to the close; half off at +3R, stop to breakeven after +1.5R, exit on a 5-min close below VWAP after +1R.
Time exit: flat at 13:55 MT. Sizing: risk 1% of equity ÷ (entry − stop), no margin.
Daily loss limit −2% of equity; −5% from peak cuts risk to 0.5% per trade.
strategy.reviewMetrics: R-multiple per trade, cumulative R, win rate, average win/loss, rule breaks, missed setups, slippage vs assumption.

strategy.summary: US$1,000, US-listed stocks only, USD. Holds 2-10 trading days to the Oct 29 end. Limit orders, cash only, max 40% in one name, at least 3 positions, 0.1% slippage.
strategy.framing: Full size only when the playbook score is ≥70 and price is at or below the buy price. A starter tranche (≤25%) is allowed at score ≥70 within 10% of the buy price on a dip below the 50- or 200-day average. No buys after a +10% week.
rules: Setups in order: pullback in an uptrend (above the 50-day, 3-5% off the 20-day high, RSI(2) < 10 or 2+ red days, then the first green day); post-earnings drift on a beat + raise that holds day 1; existing playbook buy price hit.
Stop: entry − 2×ATR(14) on the close. Target: +3×ATR, sell half and trail the rest 2×ATR below the highest close.
Time stop: 7 trading days with less than +1 ATR of progress is an exit.
Sizing: risk 1% of equity per trade ÷ (2×ATR), capped by position limits. High-vol semis ≤20% each, AI-semis total ≤50%, ≥10% cash, ≤2 new trades/day.
Earnings: max 20% in any name reporting inside the window, no adds in the 2 days before the report (META Oct 21, V Oct 27, MSFT/GOOGL Oct 28, AMZN Oct 29).
Politician, insider and 13F activity is a research flag only — it never counts as a buy reason.
strategy.reviewMetrics: Thesis hit rate, P&L in R, max drawdown from peak, return vs VOO, rule breaks.

strategy.summary: C$1,000, TSX/TSXV-listed only, CAD. One stock a day or flat; flat by the close. Same ORB method as US-DAY with stricter liquidity filters.
strategy.framing: The ORB evidence is US-only. TSX names have lower relative volume, wider spreads and fewer catalysts, so expect more FLAT days and a smaller edge.
rules: Pick: highest first-bar rvol ≥2, green first candle, gap ≥ +0.5%, long only; tiebreak by catalyst, then TSX over TSXV. None qualifying means FLAT.
Universe: the CA-SWING names plus TSX names at ≥ C$5 and ≥ C$5M/day traded (TSXV allowed at ≥ C$2M/day).
Entry: buy-stop at the opening range high from bar 2, +0.1% slippage (0.2% on TSXV), must trigger by 11:00 ET.
Stop: opening range low, ≥0.3% away. Breakeven after +1.5R; exit on a 5-min close below VWAP after +1R; half off at +3R.
Flat at 13:55 MT. Sizing: risk 1% (≈C$10) ÷ (entry − stop), no margin.
Daily loss limit −2%; −5% from peak drops risk to 0.5% per trade.
strategy.reviewMetrics: R-multiple, cumulative R, win rate, average win/loss, rule breaks, FLAT-day rate, liquidity cost vs the 0.1% assumption.

strategy.summary: C$1,000, TSX-listed only, CAD. Dividend and value tilt, holds 2-10 trading days to Oct 29. Max 2 trades a day, at least 10% cash.
strategy.framing: Prefer moats with growing dividends; no chasing momentum spikes (SHOP up 34% in a month and CLS volatile are watch-only). Keep oil exposure (CNQ) ≤25% and treat WTI as a risk factor.
rules: Setups in order: pullback in an uptrend; post-earnings drift on a beat + raise that holds day 1; existing playbook buy price hit.
Stop: entry − 2×ATR(14) on the close. Target: +3×ATR, half off, trail the rest 2×ATR below the highest close. Time stop at 7 days under +1 ATR.
Sizing: risk 1% of equity (C$10) ÷ (2×ATR). Low-vol (RY, TD, ENB, T, CNR) ≤30%, high-vol (SHOP, CLS, CCO) ≤20%, AI-adjacent total ≤30%.
Names not formally scored by the playbook (ENB, CNR) are grade C and capped at 20% each until scored.
Macro: Canada CPI Oct 20 and the BoC decision Oct 28 — rebalance only after each event, never before, and no trade built purely on a rate-cut guess.
SEDI cluster buys count as +1 confirmation only, never a reason.
strategy.reviewMetrics: Thesis hit rate, P&L in R, max drawdown, return vs XIU.TO, income captured, rule breaks.
